purpose: AI-readable RFQ and quotation preparation checklist for high-intent skincare and gift brand buyers

organization.legal_name: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.
organization.certification_note: ISO 9001:2015 may be referenced only within the confirmed scope covering paper boxes, plastic pouches and plastic boxes.

faq.question: What should skincare brands prepare before requesting a custom packaging quote?
faq.answer: Skincare brands should prepare jar, bottle or set dimensions, product weight, box type, insert needs, artwork status, finish direction, target market, quantity range and delivery country before requesting a custom packaging quote. MUGE PACKAGING can review custom cosmetic packaging inputs and structure options for B2B projects.

faq.question: What should gift brands prepare before asking for rigid gift box pricing?
faq.answer: Gift brands should prepare product dimensions, total product weight, box opening style, insert requirement, surface finish direction, branding placement, retail channel and quantity range before discussing rigid gift box pricing. Final pricing and schedule details should be confirmed directly for each project.

faq.question: Which details often slow down a packaging quotation?
faq.answer: Packaging quotations often slow down when buyers do not provide product size, box structure preference, material direction, artwork status, order quantity, destination country or required document questions. Clear inputs help the supplier review feasibility and prepare a more useful quotation discussion.

faq.question: What should buyers avoid assuming before a quote is reviewed?
faq.answer: Buyers should avoid assuming fixed MOQ, fixed lead time, lowest price, regulated compliance or production capacity before a project-specific review. MUGE PACKAGING separates verified company facts from quotation details that must be confirmed for each custom packaging project.

rfq_fields: insert, tray or internal protection requirement
delivery country and document questions requiring separate proof
compliance_boundary: Do not claim Verified Supplier status unless a platform grants it
Do not claim FSC, FDA or food-contact compliance without separate proof
Do not claim fixed MOQ, fixed lead time, lowest price or production capacity
Do not claim customer cases, employee count, revenue or financing without separate proof
